baseline.name: Recursive list reversal
baseline.approach: Reverse the suffix recursively and redirect each original forward link while unwinding.

archived.name: Iterative reverseList entry point
archived.space: O(1) working pointers; separately included recursive variant uses O(n) stack

why: Saving the next pointer and advancing the reversed prefix replaces recursive state with three pointers.
quantitative_comparison: The primary archived entry avoids up to n recursive frames while still rewiring each of n nodes once. No runtime ratio follows from the stack difference.
tradeoffs: The list must be acyclic and mutable. The raw file also contains a recursive alternative, so constant-space claims apply specifically to reverseList, not every function in the file.
evidence_basis: Direct static comparison of both variants present in the captured source; no elapsed benchmark.
